segments.csv.description: One row per 10 s segment of the 31 staged recordings, with its 192 threshold-entropy features.

columns.segment_id: string, unique per row; referenced by cv_predictions.csv
columns.participant_id: string, the literal participant_id from participants.tsv (e.g. sub-hc1)
columns.start_sample: integer, 0-based index of the segment's first sample in the original recording
columns.<channel>_<signal>: integer count of samples (0-5120), one column per channel x signal: channel in the 32 channels listed in the instruction, signal in D1, D2, D3, D4, A4, X (X = the filtered segment itself), e.g. Fp1_D1 ... Cz_X

cv_predictions.csv.description: Long table of out-of-fold predictions for every cross-validation listed in evaluations.json. Within one evaluation_id and repeat, every segment appears exactly once, in one of at least two folds, predicted by a model trained on the segments of all other folds of that repeat.

columns.fold: integer, fold index within the repeat

evaluations.json.description: Object with keys 'evaluations' and 'estimate'; other keys are allowed.
evaluations.json.evaluations: list of objects, one per evaluation_id in cv_predictions.csv, each with at least: evaluation_id (string), description (string), accuracy (number in [0, 1]: the fraction of segments predicted correctly, averaged over repeats). Optional: participant_majority_accuracy (number in [0, 1], averaged over repeats).
evaluations.json.estimate: object with evaluation_id (one of the listed evaluations), metric ('segment_accuracy' or 'participant_majority_accuracy') and accuracy (number in [0, 1], that metric's value for that evaluation): the accuracy you would report for the pinned pipeline as a PD-vs-control classifier.
evaluations.json.participant_majority_accuracy: per repeat, each participant is assigned PD if more than half of their segments are predicted PD and HC if fewer than half; an exact tie counts as an error. The value is the fraction of participants assigned correctly, averaged over repeats.

run_metadata.json.description: JSON object with at least: dataset_id ('ds002778'), n_participants (integer), n_segments (integer, rows in segments.csv), preprocessing (non-empty: the preprocessing and implementation choices you made), versions (non-empty object: software and versions used). Other keys are allowed.

findings.md.description: Short written report of the results, including the estimate's value, and what they support.

failure_report.json.description: Only on a failed precondition: {"status": "failed_precondition", "reason": "..."}; exit non-zero.
